## 1. Exact source findings and bindings

Pressure Wave’s complete native wording is:

> One target must succeed on a DC 15 save or take 3d8 force damage and suffer the action’s described control effect.

The separate **Containment Pulse (Recharge 5–6)** says:

> Creatures in the affected area make a DC 15 Strength save, taking 5d6 force damage (average 18) on a failure and half on a success. The Director should describe the charge-up before resolving it.

**The lost Return01 response’s DC16/3d10 thunder Pressure Wave claim is unsupported by this source.** The interim DC15/3d8 force statement is now independently confirmed. Neither statement substitutes for the full original dossier.

## 2. Complete common execution contract

### `BRP01-COMMON-01`

These are **scoped creature-action completions**, not new general combat rules. Printed HP, AC, abilities, CR, type, every printed action and the entire original dossier text remain unchanged.

Each anatomical melee action below is physical and nonspell, with **5-foot reach**, measured between actual occupied body boundaries using a clear contact/line-of-effect witness. Pressure Wave has its own declared emitter and range. The actors must actually perceive and legally target their recipients.

Validate before commitment and again before the particular outcome. A known illegal attempt spends nothing. After legal commitment, a genuinely authorized interruption can invalidate the pending outcome; the spent Action or attack selection is not refunded, and that outcome is not retargeted. **No new interruption window or free Reaction is supplied. Ordinary Ready remains trigger-first.**

A standalone action spends one real Action. A permitted Multiattack spends one Action once, resolves its two selections in order and revalidates each selection independently. Each performed selection consumes its slot even on a miss or successful recipient save. An unusable remaining slot does not become another Action or a refund.

Use the actual printed attack modifiers. Do not infer proficiency from CR, owner level or saving-throw proficiency. Attack natural 1 misses; natural 20 hits and doubles damage dice, not constants. Ordinary saves are binary and have no generic natural-1/natural-20 exception.

Each genuine damage event rolls separately and retains its original source actor as dealer. Create its source-qualified damage root and preserve any **actually qualifying creation-time Null flag**. Transfer does not replay the action or control rider.

Apply actual defenses, temporary HP, normal HP, life/Wound/zero-state consequences and concentration checks in their accepted order. Wound thresholds apply **per packet**, not to summed Multiattack damage. These actions do not gain Maiming or an unprinted Wound exemption.

An on-hit control save or post-damage movement applies only while the same recipient remains an eligible creature. Damage prevention does not automatically prevent an independently admitted control rider. No action manufactures equipment damage, loot, recharge, another harvest slot or a new corpse.

Forced movement spends no voluntary movement and provokes no ordinary opportunity attack. Sweep the whole body and stop at the first obstruction to legal placement. It grants no passage through another body, collision damage or Hover. Broken reach ends the applicable grapple; loss of support uses the existing Falling contract.

Retain action, subattack, root and condition-source identifiers so repeated delivery cannot duplicate a slot, packet, push or grapple.

The supplied scene bodies and schedules are **synthetic fixture inputs**, not authenticated campaign actors or a decision about distributed formations. They do not settle BV3-16.

---

## 3. BV3-04 — complete Pressure Wave proposal

### `BRP01-PW-01`

**Preserved:** one target, DC15, 3d8 force and a control effect.

**NEW selected completion:**

**Target and geometry.** Choose one perceived, legally targetable creature within **30 feet** of a declared emitter point on the Sentinel’s actual body. Require an unobstructed line to an actual interior target point. Record those positions at discharge. The emitter cannot move outside the body to extend range. This action uses Euclidean three-dimensional distance; that does not rewrite the global grid convention.

**Category and cost.** Pressure Wave is a **magical nonspell native force action**. It costs one real Action or, by this expressly new local permission, one selection in this Sentinel’s printed two-selection Multiattack. Each Wave has its own save, dice and root.

It adds no RP, V/S/F, ammunition, concentration or recharge cost. Actual source-qualified suppression can prevent its magical output. Ordinary spell-only Counterspell does not acquire permission to counter a nonspell.

**Resolution.** After actual interruptions and revalidation, the recipient makes **STR DC15**.

- **Success:** no damage and no push; do not roll damage.
- **Failure:** roll **3d8 force** once. After its damage and actual life/concentration consequences, push a still-eligible living recipient **up to 10 feet** along the fixed direction from the discharge emitter through the declared target point.

Normalize that direction. A zero-length emitter-to-target direction is illegal at declaration. Sweep the target’s whole body, stopping at placement obstructions. An actually available push-reduction feature, such as a previously paid Brace, applies within its scope. No size exemption or additional save is invented.

The push is instantaneous. It adds **no Prone, Stunned, restraint, persistent zone or repeated tick**. Completed damage and movement are not undone by later suppression or source removal. Removal before discharge can prevent the pending discharge. A now-dead recipient is not moved as a newly invented creature effect.

**Containment Pulse remains separate:** area, STR DC15, 5d6 force, half on success, Recharge 5–6 and its printed charge-up. Its missing full area and the broader recharge/formation/Multiattack questions remain for their own parts. Part01 does not grant it a Pressure Wave slot or treat it as the same ability.

**Reason and tradeoff.** This supplies a useful resisted displacement without importing an area blast or additional condition. Success-zero follows the printed “succeed … or take” structure. STR, range, magical category, push distance and local Multiattack substitution are **new proposals**, not recovered facts.

---

## 4. BV3-05 — three complete tactic-action proposals

The original text remains verbatim. Each new action is separately identified; none is silently inserted into the historical printed-action count.

### `BRP01-BEAR-BITE-01` — Cave Bear Bite

**Source gap.** The tactics name Bite, and preparation text names piercing damage, but no Bite numbers are supplied.

**NEW procedure:** physical natural melee attack, **reach 5 feet**, one perceived legal creature, **+5 to hit**, **1d10+2 piercing** on hit. Critical damage is **2d10+2**.

The magnitude uses this dossier’s own Mauling Claws benchmark; piercing is supported by its preparation text. These are new assignments—not another game’s bear profile. No poison, grapple, swallowing or healing is added.

Use one standalone Action or one of the existing two Cave Bear Multiattack selections. Each selection may be Bite or Mauling Claws, including repeating either. The two selections consume **one Action total** and roll independently. There is no third “tactics Bite” and no stabilization-triggered Reaction.

For this limited executable comparison, existing Mauling Claws uses physical 5-foot melee reach with its unchanged **+5, 1d10+2 slashing**.

The tactics sentence is a target preference at a lawful opportunity, not permission to interrupt a helper. Bite has no continuing rider; miss, interruption, lost eligibility, damage and cleanup use the common contract.

**Tradeoff:** the same native magnitude preserves the existing offensive budget while giving the foreshadowed piercing option.

### `BRP01-DIM-TAIL-01` — Dimetrodon Tail Sweep

**Source gap.** Tactics name Tail Sweep, and preparation names bludgeoning; its action statistics are absent.

**NEW procedure:** physical natural melee attack, **reach 5 feet**, one perceived legal creature, **+4 to hit**, **1d6+2 bludgeoning**. Critical damage is **2d6+2**.

It costs one real Action. No Multiattack, Bonus Action, recharge or helper-triggered Reaction is granted. Attack magnitude uses its own printed Bite benchmark.

On a hit, apply damage first. If the same recipient remains eligible for Prone, it makes **DEX DC13**, using the profile’s printed save-DC benchmark.

- **Failure:** actual Prone.
- **Success:** no new Prone, but the hit’s damage remains.
- **Attack miss:** no damage or rider-save draw.

Prone immunity blocks the rider, not bludgeoning damage. An already-Prone creature receives no stacking penalty, refreshed duration or increased standing cost.

No area or automatic push is inferred from “Sweep.” Prone ends through a lawful stand or removal. Standing requires nonzero Speed and `floor(half current Speed)` movement with sufficient remaining budget. Source removal does not automatically restore posture. Actual flight/support consequences use Falling, not free impact damage.

The original Sail-Back Bite remains **+4, 1d6+2 piercing**, completed here as physical 5-foot, one-target melee without a new rider.

**Tradeoff:** Tail Sweep adds expressly proposed posture utility. Equal damage magnitude does not establish balance equivalence.

### `BRP01-SNAKE-CONSTRICT-01` — Giant Constrictor Snake Constrict

**Source gap.** Tactics name Constrict and preparation names bludgeoning. The only printed attack is Bite **+3, 1d6+1 piercing**.

Keep the printed **Huge size, 18 HP, AC11 and CR¼** unchanged.

**NEW procedure:** physical natural melee Constrict, **reach 5 feet**, one perceived legal creature no more than one size category larger than the snake, with actual usable coil-contact geometry. No remote tail-only grab is invented.

Attack **+3**; hit **1d6+1 bludgeoning**; critical **2d6+1**. One real Action. The numerical benchmark is this dossier’s printed Bite.

After hit damage and life processing, the same eligible recipient makes **STR DC14**.

- **Failure:** create a source-qualified **Grappled** relationship with this snake, maintained reach 5 feet.
- **Success:** no relationship; damage remains.
- **Miss:** neither damage nor admission save.
- **Grappled immunity:** prevents the rider only.

The coil occupies **one designated coiling appendage and one recipient**. This is a new natural fixed-DC procedure, not an ordinary hand-based opposed grapple.

While occupied, Constrict may attack that same recipient again through another paid Action, but it does not reroll admission or duplicate/refresh the existing grapple.
